# @rnw-community/redux-loadable

> Generic Redux loading state, selectors, and reducer utils for tracking request `pristine` / `loading` / `failed` /
> `success` states. Works with Redux Toolkit and classic Redux approaches; no runtime dependencies.

The reducer utils mutate the given state and return a shallow copy, so they can be returned directly from a Redux
Toolkit `createSlice` reducer.

## Guides

- [Utils](readme.md#utils): How the reducer helpers are meant to be used inside `createSlice` reducers.

## API reference

- [`LoadingStateInterface`](readme.md#loadingstateinterface): `isPristine` / `isLoading` / `error` fields to extend a state slice with.
- [`initialLoadingState`](readme.md#initialloadingstate): `{ isPristine: true, isLoading: false, error: '' }` starting value for a loadable slice.
- [`loadingStarted`](readme.md#loadingstartedstate): Sets `isLoading: true`, clears `error`, and marks the slice non-pristine.
- [`loadingFinished`](readme.md#loadingfinishedstate): Sets `isLoading: false` and clears `error` after a successful load.
- [`loadingFailed`](readme.md#loadingfailedstate-errorreason): Sets `isLoading: false` and stores the error reason in `error`.
- [`loadingReset`](readme.md#loadingresetstate): Resets the slice's loading fields back to `initialLoadingState`.
- [`loadingStateSelector`](readme.md#loadingstateselectorslice): Curried selector returning `[isLoading, isFailed, isPristine, error]` for a named slice.

## Architecture & conventions

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community/blob/master/packages/redux-loadable/AGENTS.md): Package commands, architecture, key patterns, and coverage.
